Eyelid surgery corrects drooping upper eyelids and bags under the eyes. Upper eyelid surgery is usually done under local anaesthesia, lower eyelid surgery generally under general anaesthesia. MedLuxLife arranges your online consultation with the surgeon in Istanbul and organises your stay.

Quick facts

Anaesthesia

Local or general

Operation time

About 1–2 hours

Stitches

Removed after about 7 days

Daily activities

After about 3–5 days

Stay in Türkiye

Planned individually with the clinic

General information; your surgeon plans the details for you personally.

Who it may be suitable for

  • Your upper eyelids droop or you have bags under the eyes.
  • Excess skin may even narrow your field of vision.
  • You are in good general health and do not smoke, or are ready to stop for the surgery.

Whether the procedure is suitable for you is decided by the surgeon after a personal assessment.

Options

Upper eyelids

Removes excess skin from the upper lids; usually under local anaesthesia.

Lower eyelids

Treats bags under the eyes; generally under general anaesthesia.

How the operation is performed

Consultation with the surgeon

Before the operation, the surgeon examines you in person, discusses your wishes and confirms the final plan.

Anaesthesia and preparation

The type of anaesthesia – local or general anaesthesia – is planned with you in advance. The team marks and prepares the area to be treated.

The procedure

The surgeon removes excess skin and, where needed, fat through fine incisions in the natural folds of the eyelids.

Closure and first care

The incisions are closed with fine stitches and protected with tapes. Your surgeon tells you whether you go home the same day.

How it works with MedLuxLife

1Contact and online consultation

Contact us and tell us what you are interested in. We refer you to the right surgeon for an online consultation. Photos or medical documents go directly to the doctor, only on request.

2Your personal plan

The surgeon recommends the right approach for you. We plan your dates, flights, hotel and transfers around it.

3Arrival and surgery

After a pre-operative examination, the operation takes place as planned. Your surgeon tells you whether you can return to your hotel the same day.

4Recovery in Istanbul

You rest in your hotel and attend the check-ups at the clinic. The surgeon decides when you are ready to fly home.

5Back home

Stay in touch with us on WhatsApp – we help with follow-up questions.

Recovery step by step

First days

Swelling and bruising are normal. Most people resume light routines after 3–5 days.

Day 7

The stitches and tapes are removed by the surgeon after about 7 days.

Weeks 1–2

Most people are back to their normal routine after 1–2 weeks; swelling continues to go down.

Frequently asked questions

About 1–2 hours, depending on whether upper, lower or both eyelids are treated.

Usually after about 7 days, by your surgeon.

This is planned individually with the clinic. We organise your flights and hotel accordingly.

No. If the surgeon needs photos or documents, you share them directly with the doctor in your online consultation.

Plan your eyelid surgery

Contact us and tell us what you are interested in – we refer you to the right specialist for an online consultation.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
